patterns.note: Sections frequently use full-bleed background colors (vibrant red or very light pink) to create strong visual breaks and define distinct content blocks.
Extreme contrast in typography, pairing massive, bold, high-contrast serif headings with smaller, clean sans-serif body text and uppercase sans-serif labels for a dramatic visual hierarchy.
A high-impact, two-tone primary color scheme of vibrant red and very light pink, with white text on red and dark text on pink, creating a bold and distinctive brand identity.
The header (logo and navigation links) is sticky, maintaining its initial light pink background and white text/logo throughout the scroll, providing a constant navigation anchor.
Content sections and individual elements (text blocks, images, number counters) reveal with a staggered fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport during scroll.

technique_notes: To rebuild the motion system, use a library like GSAP ScrollTrigger to orchestrate element reveals. Implement a sticky header that maintains its initial background color and content styling as the user scrolls. Apply fade-in and subtle slide-up animations to sections and their internal elements as they become visible in the viewport, staggering the animations for a dynamic reveal effect.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold serif headings (~5-6x body text) create dramatic impact, contrasted with smaller, clean sans-serif body text and uppercase sans-serif labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners dominate most elements and sections, with subtle rounding applied only to interactive elements like CTA buttons and input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: An airy and expansive feel in hero and key sections, using large content blocks and generous vertical spacing, while maintaining a balanced density within feature grids.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its audacious and unapologetic use of a vibrant, full-bleed red as a primary brand color, combined with monumental, high-contrast serif typography. This creates an extremely bold, almost aggressive, visual identity that immediately grabs attention and conveys a strong sense of confidence and luxury.
